criterion_review.criterion: Independent final-body authority at the shared boundary
criterion_review.assessment: The two permitted projections are built before requests from fixture composition and predetermined tool-result content. The request-local wrapper selects that prebuilt projection, records the actual encoded body, calls the captured original Transport implementation and restores CURRENT in finally. It does not derive authority from observed requests. OpenAI merges extra_body and runs request preparation before HTTPX reaches this boundary. Only the lower httpcore pool is replaced. Complete request bytes, method, endpoint, auth/retry headers and the original digest comparison remain on the tested path. Model override, an unknown field and a changed tool-result reference are denied before the lower sink; same-channel positive requests reach it. Synthetic completion data drives a genuine public Runner tool invocation and continuation serialization, not inference.

criterion_review.criterion: Explicit model/client and no implicit retry or active auxiliary SDK effects
criterion_review.assessment: An explicit OpenAIChatCompletionsModel with injected AsyncOpenAI client bypasses default model-provider resolution. Client and ModelRetrySettings both set max_retries=0; SDK retry logic disables provider retries and the conversation_locked compatibility retry for this setting. The retained 503, connection-error and cancellation cases each observe exactly one attempt/sink call and no tool invocation; third-turn/retry assertions also guard successful cases. Explicit empty handoffs/MCP servers, session=None, context_management=None, store=False and tracing disabled restrict the exercised configuration. The original execution uses env -i, isolated Python and bwrap --unshare-net. No personal credential lookup or actual provider/target invocation is established by or required for the proof.
criterion_review.qualification: Do not generalize this to an intrinsically side-effect-free SDK. Its trace provider can lazily allocate an HTTPX exporter client even for disabled tracing; the disabled trace/spans enqueue nothing and do not start its export worker on this path. OpenAI 2.45.0 still consults optional OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY, OPENAI_WEBHOOK_SECRET and OPENAI_CUSTOM_HEADERS environment settings; default_headers={} alone is not environment isolation. The recorded clean environment is material to this S0 result. No ambient credential values were read by this reviewer.

criterion_review.criterion: Complete encoded-body bounds and failure cleanup
criterion_review.assessment: Recorded actual initial/continued bodies are 7917/16500 bytes. Unicode-padded continuation of 32768 bytes succeeds and 32769 fails with FINAL_DATA_DENIED; an 8192-byte NUL tool result becomes a complete 57434-byte encoded body and is denied rather than truncated. ResponseStream allows 131072 bytes and rejects the next byte with RESPONSE_LIMIT. Test assertions check exact underlying denial causes, response closure where a response exists, sink/attempt/tool counts and CURRENT restoration. Cancellation is injected before a response exists; this does not claim every mid-stream cancellation race is tested. The 10-second test timeout is not proof of an operation-owner 300-second deadline.

criterion_review.criterion: Honest IPC sizing and S0-only acceptance
criterion_review.assessment: Existing KeySettingsControl/CatalogControl and ControlRequest schemas are serialized and decoded, including Unicode/escaping, unknown-envelope rejection, 4096-byte acceptance and 4097-byte denial. JSON-whitespace padding to a 3600-byte command measures envelope capacity only. Source and handoff explicitly do not claim raw-command cap enforcement, an HTTP route effect, future Needs-you schema, Bridge, SENT/persistence/Brain consumption or a product agent loop. The selected source composition is a fixed serializer-sizing fixture, not all U02 content or all maximum refs. None of those S1 obligations is demanded as circular S0 evidence.

Programmatic comparison matches the recorded dependency delta: OpenAI is the only previously locked package version changed, from 2.24.0 to 2.45.0; cryptography stays 50.0.1. The agents pin has no extras. New MCP is an explicit transitive dependency, not an activated server. Both recorded SDK/client artifact hashes occur in the final lock. Retained closure reports 64 installed distributions, 5906 checked RECORD hashes and no mismatches; the retained audit reports 67 packages and zero vulnerabilities. This reviewer did not repeat package downloads, installation or network audit. Local pinned Strix source HEAD and both whole-source hashes match the fixture. Exact selected chunks, preserving their final newlines and joining chunks with one newline, match both selected hashes and occur literally in instructions. The referenced Apache-2.0 license copy equals pinned upstream LICENSE; no upstream root NOTICE file was present.
